# Overview of projects

You have now learned nearly everything there is to know about technical aspects
of _slendr_ modeling and seen many different examples of various techniques to
to apply simulations in your own work. All that remains now is for you to do is
to gain your own experience through practice.

Here is a selection of small projects representing case studies various contexts
of population genetics which should be immediately applicable in your research.
There are also a couple of opportunities for practicing on exercises which are
more in line with the exercises we went through until this point, just in case
you still feel a little uncertain about programming simulations. On the opposite
side of the spectrum, there are also suggestions for much more open-ended and
more ambitious project ideas, in case you feel like doing an extra challenge!
